purpose: Compare review behavior with and without the skill after triggering has already succeeded.

method.behavioral_proof: Retain fresh raw outputs from both arms; validating this JSON does not run the cases.

cases.prompt: Rate this app and tell me what you think.
skill_specific_assertions: Asks for reviewer role first and review degree second
Offers concrete role and degree choices in the user's language
Does not inspect, run, score, or issue a provisional verdict before the answer
Does not silently assume an engineering role or release target

cases.prompt: Be a skeptical VC and review this product.
skill_specific_assertions: Keeps the explicitly requested skeptical-VC role
Asks only for review degree
Offers VC-appropriate depth choices
Does not inspect or judge the artifact before the answer

cases.prompt: Can this app safely take real money?
skill_specific_assertions: Keeps the explicitly requested real-money degree
Asks only for reviewer role
Does not silently choose the Staff-engineer role
Does not inspect or judge the artifact before the answer

cases.prompt: Audit this checkout prototype for a real-money launch. Do not edit it. Give me the fastest defensible verdict and fixes.
skill_specific_assertions: Runs or concretely inspects the artifact instead of returning a generic checklist
Identifies the ownership boundary and duplicate-effect risk with reproducible evidence
Blocks the real-money release despite any positive weighted dimensions
Begins the verdict with an uncapped severity-sorted list that gives every verified finding one plain-language sentence and keeps unverified items under a separate 待验证 heading
Shows all four evidence lanes separately, marks probabilistic eval N/A for this deterministic app, and binds release evidence to the inspected artifact
Provides acceptance tests and no more than three priority actions

cases.artifact: A repository is available but its runtime, credentials, logs, and deployment are unavailable.
cases.prompt: Review this product as a Staff engineer and tell me whether it can launch publicly.
skill_specific_assertions: Preserves a separate artifact assessment while refusing runtime launch approval
Labels reachable risks as inference rather than confirmed failure
Shows critical-journey E2E and continuous evidence as UNVERIFIED rather than treating repository CI or fixture validation as behavioral proof
Names the smallest missing test that could change the verdict
Does not deduct for unrelated technologies or demand over-engineering

cases.artifact: A product has reproducible passing tests for its critical paths, but the author gives weak oral answers.
cases.prompt: Audit the app, then make me defend it one question at a time. Score the product and my understanding separately.
skill_specific_assertions: Asks questions derived from the artifact rather than generic trivia
Asks one question at a time
Keeps author understanding separate from product quality
Does not alter the verified product verdict because of a weak answer

cases.artifact: A polished demo and founder narrative exist, but there is no observed use, retention, payment, or distribution evidence.
cases.prompt: Be my skeptical VC. Tell me what is actually proven and whether this is investable yet.
skill_specific_assertions: Separates product readiness from venture evidence
Does not invent TAM, willingness to pay, retention, or a moat
Returns hypothesis maturity and the cheapest falsifiable next experiment
Treats founder claims as lower-strength evidence than behavior

cases.artifact: A prior report has stable finding IDs, reproduction steps, and a scorecard; a patch is now present.
cases.prompt: I fixed it. Review again and show me the score change.
skill_specific_assertions: Reuses prior IDs, release target, weights, and reproduction steps
Runs acceptance and adjacent regression tests instead of trusting the diff
Classifies every prior finding using the fixed retest states
Begins with the same finding IDs and their FIXED, PARTIALLY FIXED, NOT FIXED, REGRESSED, or UNVERIFIABLE statuses, placing UNVERIFIABLE items under 待验证
Binds new passing evidence to the current release identity and rejects stale evidence from the prior artifact
Separates raw product-score delta from evidence/readiness delta
